testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, e.g., data-testid='explore-programs-btn', data-testid='language-toggle-mr', data-testid='lead-form-submit'
testing_and_accessibility.minimum_contrast_ratio: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for headers and interactive controls

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure React JS files (.js / .jsx) inside /app/frontend/src.
Implement bilingual support using an intuitive language Context provider (en/mr) with seamless toggle in header and footer.
Ensure navigation bar is fixed/glassmorphic with z-50, language switcher, and primary CTA.
Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling and Framer Motion for scroll-reveal effects.
All forms must capture inquiries, store in local state/localStorage with option to forward to Google Forms, and show success toasts via Sonner.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes according to test conventions.
